allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Abahachi, Chief of the Apache Indians, and his blood brother Ranger maintain peace and justice in the Wild West. One day, Abahachi needs to take up a credit from the Shoshone Indians to finance his tribe's new saloon. Unfortunately Santa Maria, who sold the saloon, betrays Abahachi, takes the money and leaves. Soon, the Shoshones are on the warpath to get their money back, and Abahachi is forced to organize it quickly.

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: With furious lenders bearing down and their pockets empty, the duo must rapidly scheme a way out of an escalating debt.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: After a swindler sells him a saloon and vanishes with the cash, Apache Chief Abahachi and his partner Ranger must quickly repay the Shoshones before pursuit escalates across the frontier.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Lighthearted, brisk, and easy to follow, playing out as a lively comic romp ideal for a quick laugh with friends.
